title: Prophet Ibrahim
description: The fire, the idols, the Ka'bah and the friend of Allah.

questions.prompt: Name something from the story of Prophet Ibrahim (AS).

notAccepted.message: That's in the question — name something else from the story!

answers.explanation: He was thrown into a great fire, which Allah made cool and safe.
His son, who helped him raise the Ka'bah and submitted to the sacrifice.
He and Isma'il raised the foundations of the House.
He saw in a dream that he was sacrificing his son; a great sacrifice was given in his place.
He broke his people's idols and left the biggest one.
Mother of Isma'il, left with him in the valley of Makkah; named in the Hadith.
His wife, given the good news of Ishaq in old age.
His son born to Sarah in old age.
The spring that gushed for Hajar and baby Isma'il.
He showed his people that the star, moon and sun set, so none is a god.
His father, who worshipped idols.

answers.canonical: The king who argued with him
answers.explanation: He told the king that Allah brings the sun from the east, "so bring it from the west".
He served angels a roasted calf, not knowing who they were.
Hajar ran between the two hills looking for water.
He left his family in an uncultivated valley by the Sacred House.
His nephew, who believed in him and emigrated with him.
He asked to see how Allah gives life to the dead and was shown four birds brought back to life.
"And Allah took Ibrahim as an intimate friend."
The stone he stood on while building, now beside the Ka'bah.
He was "upright", turning away from all false gods.

questions.prompt: Name a du'a of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in the Qur'an.

answers.explanation: "My Lord, make this city secure."
"Our Lord, accept this from us" — while raising the Ka'bah.
"Our Lord, raise up among them a messenger from themselves."
"My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants."
"Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established."
"My Lord, grant me one of the righteous."
"Keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols."
"Provide its people with fruits."
"Make the hearts of people incline towards them."

answers.canonical: Show me how You give life to the dead
variants: Show me how you give life
answers.explanation: "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead."
"Our Lord, make us submissive to You, and from our descendants a nation submissive to You."
"And show us our rites."

answers.canonical: A good mention among later people
answers.explanation: "Grant me a reputation of truth among later generations."

answers.canonical: Make me an heir of the Garden of Bliss
answers.explanation: "Place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss."

answers.canonical: Do not disgrace me on the Day
answers.explanation: "Do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected."

questions.prompt: Name an argument Prophet Ibrahim (AS) used against idol worship.

answers.canonical: The star, moon and sun set
answers.explanation: "I do not like those that set."
"Do they hear you when you call? Or benefit you, or harm?"
He left the biggest idol and said: "Ask them, if they can speak."

answers.canonical: Bring the sun from the west
variants: Bring the sun from the west
answers.explanation: "Allah brings the sun from the east, so bring it from the west."
"My Lord is the one who gives life and causes death."
"Do you worship what you carve, while Allah created you and what you do?"
They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."

answers.canonical: His Lord created, guides, feeds and heals
answers.explanation: "He created me and guides me… feeds me… and when I am ill, He heals me."

answers.canonical: Why worship what cannot see or hear?
answers.explanation: To his father: "Why do you worship what neither hears nor sees?"

answers.explanation: "Allah took Ibrahim as an intimate friend."
Upright, turning away from falsehood.
"I will make you a leader for mankind."
"There is a good example for you in Ibrahim."
"He was a man of truth, a prophet."
"Ibrahim was tender-hearted and forbearing."
Forbearing.
Always turning back to Allah.
"Grateful for His blessings."
"Ibrahim was a nation (ummah), devoutly obedient to Allah."
Devoutly obedient.
"And Ibrahim, who fulfilled [his obligations]."

questions.prompt: Name a test Prophet Ibrahim (AS) faced.

answers.explanation: His people threw him into a great fire.

answers.canonical: Leaving his family in the desert

He was given children only in old age.
A king argued with him about his Lord.
"When his Lord tried him with commands and he fulfilled them."
A tyrant tried to take Sarah; Allah protected her and she was given Hajar.

questions.prompt: Name something from the story of Ibrahim (AS), Hajar and Isma'il (AS).

answers.explanation: Ibrahim and Isma'il raised its foundations.
Water gushed for Hajar and her baby.
Isma'il said: "Father, do as you are commanded."

questions.prompt: Name something the Hadith says about Prophet Ibrahim (AS).

answers.canonical: Blessings on Ibrahim in the salah
answers.explanation: "…as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim."
The long hadith of Hajar, Isma'il and the spring.

"Look at your companion" — the Prophet ﷺ said he resembled Ibrahim most.
Known for his hospitality to guests.

answers.canonical: First to be clothed on the Day
answers.explanation: "The first to be clothed on the Day of Resurrection will be Ibrahim."
He circumcised himself at the age of eighty.
